Three.js r184 addons used by Worldloom

GLTFLoader.js
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r184/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js

SkeletonUtils.js
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r184/examples/jsm/utils/SkeletonUtils.js

BufferGeometryUtils.js
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r184/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js

Official r184 post-processing modules:
EffectComposer.js, Pass.js, RenderPass.js, ShaderPass.js, MaskPass.js,
OutputPass.js, GTAOPass.js, UnrealBloomPass.js, CopyShader.js,
OutputShader.js, FXAAShader.js, GTAOShader.js, PoissonDenoiseShader.js,
LuminosityHighPassShader.js, and SimplexNoise.js.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r184/examples/jsm

The import specifiers and relative module locations were adjusted to use
Worldloom's vendored r184 module.
These files are covered by the Three.js MIT license in THREE-LICENSE.txt.
